description: A link to Etapa's website where the rider signs in with Google (or Apple) and lets this chat in, making their account if they have none. The other way in to `etapa_send_code`. Only after they have agreed to all four agreements in `etapa_signup_questions`. Give them the link as it is, then call `etapa_finish_sign_in`.
name: etapa_sign_in_link
title: Etapa sign-up: sign in with Google
